item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Curry-marinated and roasted chicken with rice and a lovely Danish coconut curry sauce with carrot, onion and apple, topped with parsley. Served with accompaniments.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Moroccan turkey tagine with plenty of vegetables, served with couscous tossed with herbs and topped with dried fruit. With lemon yoghurt, harissa chilli, coriander and a cucumber-tomato salad. Gluten free with rice. (1+6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Moroccan cauliflower tagine with plenty of vegetables, served with couscous tossed with herbs and topped with dried fruit. With lemon yoghurt, harissa sauce, coriander and a cucumber-tomato salad. Gluten free with rice. (1+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Albondigas with beef served with crisp patatas bravas, a spiced tomato sauce and aioli. (2+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Vegan meatballs served with patatas bravas, a spiced tomato sauce and aioli. (13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Tacos carnitas – Mexican pork collar simmered with onion, garlic and chilli until completely tender. With a salsa of avocado, pickled red onion, cucumber and padron pepper, seasoned with lime and herbs. (1+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Jackfruit tacos – jackfruit simmered with onion, garlic and chilli until completely tender. With a salsa of avocado, pickled red onion, cucumber and padron pepper, seasoned with lime and herbs. (1+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Beef Tacos de Harina – served as an open tomato wrap filled with pulled beef, spiced potatoes and vegetables, topped with herb-spiced beans. With chipotle crema, salsa verde (tomatillo salsa) and pico de gallo. Also served gluten free. (1+6+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Oyster Mushroom Tacos de Harina – served as an open tomato wrap filled with pulled oyster mushrooms, spiced potatoes and vegetables, topped with herb-spiced beans. With chipotle crema, salsa verde (tomatillo salsa) and pico de gallo. Also served gluten free. (1+6+11+13+15)
